page.overview:
Who is Corynna?

Corynna was a human female who served as concierge in Crimson Dawn to Dryden Vos. She was executed by Vos after she tried to poison guards meals who worked for Vos.

Corynna met with Sarkin Enneb to collect a debt that was owed to Crimson Dawn. She took interest in Qi'ra who delivered the credits and decided to purchase her from Enneb. They boarded a shuttle and Corynna observed Qi'ra throughout the trip. She informed the girl that she had purchased her due the concierge's knowledge of Vos' preferences. When they arrived at the First Light, she ordered Margo to get Qi'ra cleaned up while she went to meet Vos.

After several months, Corynna grew to resent Qi'ra and would often punish her for infractions during her training. In 12 BBY, She was called to Vos's office to witness Qi'ra receiving the tattoo of the Crimson Dawn symbol on her wrist which indicated she was a member of the criminal organization.

She continued to train Qi'ra after her return from Thorum. She attended a meeting on Nightsend with Vos and other Crimson Dawn members. While there, Corynna arranged future meetings with other members of the Five Crime Syndicates.
